Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 121: April 2011
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #121 shipped to subscribers in March 2011 (bearing the cover date of April 2011 for Issue 121). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #121 featured high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom downloadable content, and exclusive media previews:

Red Faction: Armageddon (third-person action-shooter)
MX vs. ATV Alive (off-road racing simulation)
Virtua Tennis 4 (sports tennis simulation)
Bangai-O HD: Missile Fury (Xbox Live Arcade tactical bullet-hell shooter)
Moon Diver (Xbox Live Arcade side-scrolling action-platformer)
Anomaly: Warzone Earth (Xbox Live Arcade reverse tower defense)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc included downloadable gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews--featuring coverage for The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3, and Battlefield 3, alongside OXM's monthly Review Roundup and Top Plays segment.
